ad_intro:
Libas (libas.in) is a Ethnic Wear brand running ~45 active Meta creatives in India with estimated spend Rs.1-2 Cr/mo and ads pointing to website traffic to subscription/checkout. Ethnic-wear D2C scaling on lookbook-led drops.

The funnel leaks at three points: (1) Creative: lookbook static, try-on reels thin - The gap: try-on / styling Reels. (2) Landing page: a lookbook-static catalog with no try-on or size-fit UGC. (3) Tracking: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific..

These are fixable in 7 days; we estimate ~30-40% of ad spend is wasted. Enterprise lead in active scaling/cost mode - pitch efficiency and CVR, not more spend.
ad_intelligence: Meta (Facebook + Instagram) primary; Google Search + YouTube secondary; app-install where relevant.
Several evergreen creatives running 30+ days - winners, but fatigue risk and a thin refresh cadence.
Category-siloed with limited concept testing; light UGC injection.
findings: Creative leak: Lookbook static, try-on Reels thin. The gap: try-on / styling Reels.
Copy leak: Current angle is static catalog-led. Missing angle: occasion + fit story over festive-discount only.
Landing page leak: A lookbook-static catalog with no try-on or size-fit UGC.
Tracking leak: Pixel/GTM not verifiable on first paint; retargeting appears one-size-fits-all rather than segment-specific.
wins: WIN 1 - Creative: Deploy try-on / styling Reels
Shoot 15 fifteen-second try-on / styling Reels and replace 30% of the weakest creatives. Expected: CTR +30-50%, CPA -15-25% within 10 days.
WIN 2 - CRO: Fix the landing experience
Add try-on Reels + size-fit guides on collection pages. Expected: CVR +30-40%.
WIN 3 - Tracking: Server-Side CAPI + Segment Retargeting

Fire Meta Pixel + CAPI server-side on key conversion events; build 3 retargeting audiences (visited but didn't convert / started checkout / dropped off) with segment-specific creatives. Expected: recapture 10-15% of dropped conversions; cleaner attribution.
